policy: Independently reviewed original artifacts submitted before the 2026-11-10 probability gate. Dates alone never grant eligibility. Additions require a separate review of provenance, canonical folds and IDs, prediction types, and recomputed cached metrics. Replacement artifacts must satisfy the ordinary probability policy.

artifacts.metric_policy: Recompute BA, accuracy and F1 from the original decisions. Verify legacy cached rocauc against BA; probability ROC AUC remains unavailable.
